findings.evidence: False positive; no user files or documents are read or sent. (1) ImageUtils.kt:68 and WikiConnection.kt:101,151 match '*/*' only because it is part of HTTP Accept header values for downloads, not a file selector. (2) core/parser is a JVM command-line tool (build.gradle.kts plugins convention.kotlin-jvm + application, run through :core:parser:runHeroes and runItems) that downloads public wiki and Valve content on the developer machine. No module depends on it, so it is not in the shipped app. (3) CameraPermission.kt:12 requests WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, but that permission is declared in no manifest, and the callback at CameraFragment.kt:103 is empty, so it grants nothing. The feature:camera modules are also absent from app/build.gradle.kts; only feature/camera/demo and micro-benchmark depend on them. The only code writing to shared storage is CameraFragment.kt:186 in class CameraX, which has no callers, and it writes locally with no network sink. Disclosure step skipped because is_transferred is false.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration is needed for this data type. Optional cleanup: remove WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE from CameraPermission.kt and delete the unused CameraX class in CameraFragment.kt, because neither has any effect. Re-audit if feature:camera is ever added to the app module.

findings.evidence: False positive; no audio is captured. The 'record' matches refer to CameraX video recording. RecorderCameraX.kt:82-84 calls prepareRecording(...).start(...) without withAudioEnabled(), so the output has no audio track. RECORD_AUDIO is absent from every manifest and from manifest_details.json, and no withAudioEnabled, MediaRecorder or AudioRecord usage exists in the source. The 2-second clip is written to app-private storage (RecorderCameraX.kt:72-74, filesDir/temp/CameraX-recording.mp4, deleteOnExit). Its File is returned through Controller.kt:87-95 into CameraViewModel.startRecording state, and the only consumer in CameraFragment.kt:67-68 is commented out. feature/camera contains no HTTP client, upload or ACTION_SEND code. RecorderSingleCompletion.kt only guards against repeat starts. The feature:camera modules are also not dependencies of app/build.gradle.kts, so this code is not in the shipped app. Disclosure step skipped because is_transferred is false.
findings.recommendation: No Data Safety declaration is needed for this data type. If feature:camera is added to the app module, or recording gains audio or upload, re-run this audit and update the Data Safety form. The user's form declares no data collected.
